versions.changelog:
Initial release: expert, unbiased treadmill specification and recommendation consultant.

- Guides users through targeted questions on body profile, usage, space, and region.
- Calculates precise recommendations for motor CHP, belt size, and weight capacity based on verified industry standards.
- Delivers structured advice: non-negotiable, recommended, and optional specs, plus up to five matching products.
- Avoids marketing language and brand bias; purely evidence-based guidance.
- Intended for new buyers or those seeking informed treadmill upgrade advice.
